page.content:
In the year 25,793 BBY, the Devaronian Kallak assassin Jaris Kan was hired by Baron Garto of the planet of Shikaakwa to kill Baron Volnos Ryo. However, Kan's assassination attempt was thwarted by Ryo's daughter Tasha.

page.overview:
What is Assassination attempt on Baron Volnos Ryo?

In the year 25,793 BBY, the Devaronian Kallak assassin Jaris Kan was hired by Baron Garto of the planet of Shikaakwa to kill Baron Volnos Ryo. However, Kan's assassination attempt was thwarted by Ryo's daughter Tasha.
